title: Un chiffre dans l'article
summary: Samira checks the source and the size of a survey before repeating a promising public claim.

sentences.fr: Un article local affirmait que huit personnes sur dix trouvaient les ateliers du soir plus utiles.
sentences.en: A local article claimed that eight people out of ten found evening workshops more useful.

sentences.fr: Samira a cherché la source du chiffre et a découvert qu'il venait d'un sondage envoyé aux personnes déjà inscrites.
sentences.en: Samira looked for the source of the figure and found it came from a survey sent to people already registered.

sentences.fr: Le sondage comptait quarante réponses, alors que le centre accueillait plusieurs centaines de participants chaque année.
sentences.en: The survey had forty responses, while the centre welcomed several hundred participants each year.

sentences.fr: Cela ne rendait pas les réponses inutiles, mais limitait ce qu'elles permettaient de conclure.
sentences.en: That did not make the responses useless, but it limited what they could support.

sentences.fr: Samira a aussi remarqué que la question comparait les ateliers du soir à une formule précise, pas à toutes les autres options.
sentences.en: Samira also noticed that the question compared evening workshops with one specific format, not every other option.

sentences.fr: Dans son compte rendu, elle a conservé le résultat tout en décrivant la méthode et ses limites.
sentences.en: In her summary, she kept the result while describing the method and its limits.

sentences.fr: Elle a conclu que ce sondage donnait un indice intéressant, sans prouver une préférence générale.
sentences.en: She concluded that the survey offered an interesting clue without proving a general preference.
sentences.note: When reporting a survey, include who answered and what question was asked; a percentage without its method can sound more conclusive than it is.

quiz.prompt: Why did the number of responses matter?
options: The survey had measured every available option

quiz.explain: The text compares forty responses with several hundred yearly participants.
